newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville Power next-day offers unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville Power next-day offers unchanged.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) left prices and volumes for Thursday surplus power sales unchanged from the previous day, the agency said Wednesday.
BPA continued to offer up to 200 megawatts (MW) of firm power for Thursday at $14.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest deliveries and $15.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
Firm off-peak prices were unchanged at $10.50 per MWh for all deliveries.
Up to 500 MW of non-firm power for hours ending 0800-1000 and 1800-2000 PDT was offered at $15.00 (Northwest) and $16.00 (COB).
Non-firm power during shoulder hours (1100-1700 and 2100-2200) was offered at $12.00 (Northwest) and $13.00 (COB).
Non-firm power during off-peak hours was offered $10.50 (hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400) and at $11.50 (0600, 2300 PDT) for all deliveries.
BPA also continued to offer displacement power for hours ending 0100-0600 and 2400 PST at $9.00 per MWh and at $7.00 for Northwest buyers only.
